/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' -g 'src/types/messages.ts' -g 'src/index.ts' -g 'specs/**' -g '*test*' | sed -n '1,240p' && git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/index.ts && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(transport): accept bare session list frames"'
